The issuer shows a strong balance sheet, with substantial equity support (shareholders’ equity nearly 58% of assets), solid liquidity (current ratio 1.92), and very strong operating profitability (EBIT margin around 44%). While total liabilities are meaningful in absolute size, the capitalization and retained earnings profile point to a conservatively financed, high-quality investment-grade credit, though not enough information is present to justify the very highest AA/AAA range.

DECISION: A+
